goal: Publish a stable VII release that does not run maintenance during customer navigation and shows a verified result for every eligible unit in a dated whole-property check.

intent_model.literal_request: Fix the recurring page-not-loaded error and show all suite/unit results when dates were checked for the whole property; publish and add to QQQAAA.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Browsing stays stable and every unit is independently actionable without borrowed availability or price.
likely_rejections: The error returns after more navigation
Only one unit still has a real result

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Every eligible supplier room is checked independently, not merely listed.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Each room card has a room-scoped status and price when verified.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: The visitor sees one stable page and one clear result per unit.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Choose an available unit or change dates.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open the exact unit booking or date picker.

natural_destination: Public VII browsing and supplier-backed vacation business pages.

facts.claim: The public worker currently starts catalog maintenance and the broad QA runner from every anonymous HTML request.
facts.evidence: worker/index.ts v661 contains two shouldStartQualityHeartbeat blocks in fetch().

facts.claim: The current business page derives complete price data from one supplier-selected room and only uses calendar room IDs for the remaining cards.

assumptions.claim: The recurring error is caused by per-navigation worker resource pressure or a release asset mismatch.
assumptions.validation: Competing hypotheses are tested in the root-cause manifest; only supported mechanisms are changed.

in_scope: unit cards and exact booking links
invariants: Scheduled QA and catalog refresh remain active
One exact room remains required for checkout
Existing design and unrelated routes remain unchanged

requirements.statement: Anonymous browsing must not start expensive maintenance jobs and known release-asset mismatches recover once without an endless loop.
A dated whole-property check returns an independent verified result for every eligible supplier unit.
Both failures are permanent QQQAAA release blockers and the exact candidate is published and verified.

acceptance_checks.action: Open representative search and business routes.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No customer request starts the QA or catalog scheduler and every route remains usable.

acceptance_checks.setup: A known stale dynamic-import or chunk error reaches the global boundary.
acceptance_checks.action: Allow the bounded recovery to run twice.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The first occurrence clears the old public cache and reloads once; a repeat never loops and shows an actionable error.

acceptance_checks.setup: A published multi-unit property with dates and party selected.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Each eligible room has its own room-scoped supplier result and only its own verified price; one failure does not erase siblings.

acceptance_checks.setup: One unit is unavailable or its supplier call fails.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: That unit is marked unavailable or unverified without inheriting another room's price; successful units remain visible.

acceptance_checks.action: Reload desktop and mobile pages and execute QQQAAA.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The public behavior persists and both dedicated checks remain in QQQAAA.

acceptance_checks.setup: A frozen candidate and known v661 baseline.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The candidate passes or v661 remains available as the recorded rollback.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, read-only supplier checks, tests and one production publication are authorized. No data mutation, booking, lead or outbound message is authorized.
